label: <DEL> step of length-3 sequences, boosted by first token b/i/h/s/d/v/l or last token w
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (100% of mass). 99% of mass is at L=3 (t=3); the rest is a few L=4 delimiters. It never fires in the original or copy phases. Only about 15% of L=3 delimiters fire. Which ones fire depends on token identity: first token (the token about to be output) b, i, h or s gives the most lift, d, v or l less, and a last token w (prev_tok) also raises the rate. Sequences with no digits make up 87% of the mass. Top activations look like b s w / i s w / b b w. The dev predicate L3-delimiter & (first token in {b,i,h,s,d,v,l} or last token w) gets F1 0.58 and mass recall 0.91, so the token selectivity is captured only roughly. Plain (phase==1)&(L==3) recovers 99% of the mass at 15% precision.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the token being output (most: b, i, h, s, d, f; least: t, -, z, q) and the third original token (most: w, z, n, k, j, t; least: h, a, q, d); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=3, L=3, t=3.
